text: The ACCC Insurance Monitoring Program is an initiative by the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission to oversee and report on the insurance market outcomes following the establishment of a government-backed cyclone and cyclone-related flood damage reinsurance pool. The program aims to ensure that the savings from the reinsurance pool are passed on to policyholders, particularly in cyclone-exposed regions, by monitoring costs, pricing, and the pass-through of reinsurance savings.
